item.title: Chrome is removing XSLT on November 17, 2026: what breaks and what to do
item.description:
Quick answer: Chrome removes built-in XSLT support in version 158, shipping November 17, 2026, with deprecation warnings already appearing since Chrome 142–143 (official announcement). Both the XSLTProcessor JavaScript API and <?xml-stylesheet?> processing instructions stop working. Firefox and WebKit have signalled they will follow. Your migration options are a WASM polyfill, server-side transformation, or build-time precompilation — and you can verify today whether your stylesheets run correctly outside the browser.
